notes: The author's model pipeline verbatim: PROC LOGISTIC fits LOAN_APPROVAL_STATUS on the full CLASS/MODEL predictor set and persists it with OUTMODEL, then a second PROC LOGISTIC reloads it via INMODEL and SCOREs the held-out TESTING_DS into TESTING_LAS_PRED_TP078400_DS. autoexec aliases LIB78400 to WORK and rebuilds both TRAINING_DS (20 rows) and TESTING_DS (10 rows) from the repo CSVs. With this small sample the fit is quasi-completely separable (a normal small-n statistical property, not a defect); pinned fields are the deterministic model-written / scored NOTE lines, not the numeric estimates.
